assumptions: Touch input, interruptions, device variation, and constrained session windows may shape the experience.
Store policy, regional policy, privacy, and purchase disclosure may constrain monetization.
questions: Which critical actions work through touch and accessible alternatives across supported devices?
What is the minimum satisfying short session and how does interruption recovery work?
Which client-side actions require offline tolerance and which require authoritative validation?
Which store, regional, privacy, and purchase policies apply to every monetized surface?

positions.live-service-rpg: long-form progression and recurring content arcs
positions.mobile: short satisfying sessions with interruption recovery
client-tolerant degraded and offline interaction where justified
touch-first critical paths across device sizes
positions.pc-console: controller-first and keyboard-mouse parity where supported

positions.mobile: mobile-store regional policy, privacy, and purchase disclosure
positions.pc-console: platform-holder certification, commerce, entitlement, and refund policy
